evidence_layer: read-only offline analysis of recorded integrated simulation
method: Last preceding observation and state delivery gap in [0,30) ms; abs((decision_stamp_ns-capture_ns)-round(observation.scan_age_s*1e9)) < 5000000 ns; goal2 reception ROS time (45.873,224.657). Pairing is inferred because old trace lacks exact shared observation sequence.
percentile: nearest rank ceil(.95*n); sample maximum is not a timing bound
limitations: 653 selected pairs of 723 observation / 724 state samples, not full population
Observation stamp is after process_scans before snapshot; cannot split raw receipt, queue, TF wait, or processing-start age
No inference that independent TF readiness equals policy TF readiness
Stage wall durations overlap and are not additive percentiles
correction: Initial console estimate 654/485/291 used float seconds subtraction; exact integer 5 ms pairing boundary excludes one exactly-5ms sample, yielding 653/484/290. 194 already-expired unchanged.
